name: reader-scenario-attribution
goal: Recorded evidence readers are attributed to two headless scenarios whose existing integration tests are observed through the unchanged verification wrapper

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: 27 recorded-evidence reader units had no scenario, so an entity could show no recorded behaviour. Expected: two headless scenarios, one per package, whose existing integration tests are observed by the unchanged wrapper and attributed to the units they exercise

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: The wrapper refused both names with Unknown verification scenario, runner, target or package (exit 1), and 27 reader units listed no scenario: /tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-red.log. Before-hashes of tests, sources and wrapper: /tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-before.txt

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Scenarios desktop-recorded-evidence and hub-recorded-evidence; test/recorded-evidence-scopes.ts with every test name mapped to a state; three Hub tests import the instrumented expect; 48 unit manifests attributed, 11 reader contracts declare their refusals. No production source changed

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Dirty-tree smoke only: six wrapper runs exit 0 under HARNESS_SCENARIO; both scenarios have output and assertion captures for 9 of 9 states; 14 and 19 tests observed, all passed, none pending (/tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-green.log). Hub 423 tests, root and Hub types, lint, prettier and units check pass. Not a sealed clean run

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Credit only units whose functions the scenario tests execute
steps.evidence: V8 coverage of the scenario tests: hub-artifact-commit only evaluated and media-facts never loaded in Hub tests, so both left hub-recorded-evidence; the types-only desktop-evidence-types left the desktop scenario. Controller test added as state http-boundary; HubApiController and HubProjectionService credited. Seven wrapper runs exit 0 on the dirty tree: 9 and 10 states with output and assertions, 14 and 25 tests passed (/tmp/harness-reader-scenarios-green2.log)
